thread:
Mira: Quick weekly release-train bulletin + safety window heads-up. Two items: small changelog and a short safety window tonight 20:30-21:30 UTC for infra patching and perf validation.
Mira: Changelog highlights: 1) batching improvements for small requests (saves ~8% CPU), 2) minor logits-stability fix for streaming, 3) docs update for Dedicated config flags.
Jon: Thanks. Are these changes going to affect canary behavior?
Mira: Canaries for model-serving will remain active but traffic will be capped at 5% during the window. We want to validate perf under constrained conditions before expanding.
infra-bot: Safety window enabled at 1765503000. Nightly deploys to prod are blocked; CI -> staging unaffected.
Priya: Is the safety window because of the GPU driver rollout? We saw a couple noisy nodes yesterday.
Mira: Yes @Priya 1. Driver minor patch + a runtime mem-trim improvement. We're doing a controlled rollout to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
Ben: For anyone with Dedicated migrations in the next 24h, please flag now. We might need to defer.
CS-bot: Customer notifications: two customers scheduled tonight; outreach templates drafted. Link: https://go/redwood/dedicated-rollouts
Jon: If I need an exception for an urgent demo, what's the process?
Mira: Submit an exception via the release exceptions form and add the label `rel-exception`. Include CI artifacts, validation steps, and a rollback plan. We'll review within 15 minutes during the ops check-in.
Priya: How do we validate the batching change locally? Any smoke commands?
Mira: Run this quick smoke: ```bash
# local smoke to compare latency p95
python -m scripts/bench_batching --model small --concurrency 8 --count 200
```
Mira: If you see >10% p95 regression, stop and file a ticket.
infra-bot: Canary traffic limit set. Monitoring dashboards pinned: /dashboards/release-train-batch-2026. Alerts muted for routine noise for the window but not for SLO breaches.
Ben: Will there be a post-window readout?
Mira: Yes 1 summary at 21:45 UTC in this thread and a short doc in the release notes board. Please keep replies here so we have a single archive.
Jon: Copy. I'll hold my v3.6 canary until after readout.
Priya: Noted. I'll run the smoke and report within the window.
CS-bot: If any customer-facing impact happens, tag @cs-ops and use the incident template: https://go/redwood/incident-template
Mira: Thanks team. Small ask: if you touch model-serving flags, mention the PR in the thread and include perf artifacts. Helps the roll-forward decisions.
Ben: Appreciate it. See you in the readout. :coffee:
